moments.title: Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games Finale
moments.blurb: The Commonwealth Games in Glasgow are wrapping up this weekend, with the closing ceremony on August 2nd after 11 days of competition.

angles.name: General excitement
angles.copy: It's the final weekend for the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow! What's been your favourite moment of the Games?

angles.name: Scottish focus
angles.copy: Glasgow has been an incredible host for the Commonwealth Games! Who's ready for the closing ceremony on Sunday?

moments.title: AIG Women's Open Final Weekend
moments.blurb: The AIG Women's Open golf championship at Royal Lytham & St Annes concludes this weekend, running until August 2nd.

angles.name: Weekend sport
angles.copy: Top-tier golf action is on in England this weekend as the AIG Women's Open reaches its climax at Royal Lytham & St Annes.

moments.title: Lil Uzi Vert's 31st Birthday
moments.blurb: American rapper and singer-songwriter Lil Uzi Vert, known for hits like 'XO Tour Llif3', turns 31 today.

angles.name: Birthday shout-out
angles.copy: Happy 31st Birthday to the one and only Lil Uzi Vert! What's your favourite track?

moments.title: Fatboy Slim's 63rd Birthday
moments.blurb: Legendary English DJ and producer Norman Cook, better known as Fatboy Slim, celebrates his 63rd birthday today.

angles.name: Iconic DJ
angles.copy: Praise You! Happy 63rd Birthday to the absolute legend that is Fatboy Slim! What's his ultimate anthem for you?

moments.title: Will Champion (Coldplay) 48th Birthday
moments.blurb: Coldplay drummer Will Champion, co-founder of one of the world's biggest bands, turns 48 today.

angles.name: Coldplay drummer
angles.copy: Sending big birthday wishes to Coldplay's brilliant drummer, Will Champion, who turns 48 today!

moments.title: Bill Berry (R.E.M.) 68th Birthday
moments.blurb: Former R.E.M. drummer and co-founder Bill Berry, who helped write hits like 'Everybody Hurts', celebrates his 68th birthday.

angles.name: R.E.M. legend
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to Bill Berry, the legendary drummer from R.E.M.! What's your go-to R.E.M. track?

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold UK #1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' remains at number one on the UK Singles Chart for the week ending July 29, 2026, making it the longest-running UK number one of all time.

angles.name: Chart topper
angles.copy: Still at number one! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' holds strong on the UK Singles Chart for another week, making history as the longest-running UK #1 ever! What a track!

moments.title: Shakira & Burna Boy's 'Dai Dai' at #2
moments.blurb: Shakira & Burna Boy's World Cup anthem 'Dai Dai' is holding strong at number two on the UK Singles Chart.

angles.name: Global hit
angles.copy: Shakira & Burna Boy's 'Dai Dai' is still lighting up the charts at number 2! That World Cup anthem energy is still going strong.

moments.title: Oasis' 'Wonderwall' back in Top 10
moments.blurb: Oasis' iconic track 'Wonderwall' has re-entered the UK Singles Chart Top 10, currently sitting at number 8.

angles.name: Timeless classic
angles.copy: Some songs just never die! Oasis's 'Wonderwall' is back in the UK Top 10. What an absolute anthem!

moments.title: Camp Bestival Shropshire Underway
moments.blurb: Camp Bestival Shropshire is currently in full swing, offering family-friendly fun and music until August 2nd.

angles.name: Festival vibes
angles.copy: Who's at Camp Bestival Shropshire this weekend? The festival fun continues until Sunday!

moments.title: Radar Festival Kicks Off
moments.blurb: Radar Festival, celebrating progressive music, begins today and runs through to August 2nd.

angles.name: Prog rock weekend
angles.copy: Radar Festival is ON! Get ready for a weekend of incredible progressive music, running until Sunday!

moments.title: Welsh National Eisteddfod Begins
moments.blurb: The Welsh National Eisteddfod, a celebration of Welsh arts and culture, starts tomorrow, August 1st, in Pembrokeshire and runs until August 8th.

angles.name: Welsh culture
angles.copy: Hwyl Fawr! The Welsh National Eisteddfod kicks off tomorrow in Pembrokeshire! Who's heading along to celebrate Welsh culture and arts?

moments.title: The Kooks in Margate
moments.blurb: The Kooks are playing a special show at Dreamland, Margate, tomorrow, August 1st, celebrating 20 years of 'Inside In/Inside Out'.

angles.name: Indie anniversary gig
angles.copy: Catch The Kooks at Dreamland, Margate tomorrow as they celebrate 20 years of 'Inside In/Inside Out'! Who's got their tickets?

moments.title: Calvin Harris in Glasgow
moments.blurb: Calvin Harris will headline Hampden Park Stadium in Glasgow tomorrow, August 1st, for a massive show.

angles.name: Dance superstar live
angles.copy: Glasgow, are you ready?! Calvin Harris takes over Hampden Park tomorrow for what's sure to be an epic night!

moments.title: Roots Picnic London Debut
moments.blurb: The globally celebrated hip hop festival, Roots Picnic, makes its international debut at Crystal Palace Bowl, London, on August 8-9, 2026.

angles.name: Hip Hop festival
angles.copy: Get ready, London! The Roots Picnic is bringing its world-class hip hop festival to Crystal Palace Bowl next weekend, August 8th-9th!

moments.title: European Athletics Championships Birmingham
moments.blurb: The European Athletics Championships will be held in Birmingham from August 10th to 16th, bringing top athletes to the UK.

angles.name: Athletics anticipation
angles.copy: Birmingham is gearing up to host the European Athletics Championships, starting August 10th! Who are you excited to see compete?
